Name: SDV MultiTweak
Author: deltaone
Description:
Various tweaks for comfort gaming[b]

Install:[/b]
   Unpack archive content to game folder

[b]Setup:[/b]
   Simple run _mod.setup.exe, select tweaks to apply and press button install

[b]Uninstall:[/b]
   run _mod.setup.exe once more

[b]Sources:[/b]
[url=https://github.com/deltaone/dotNetModdingTools]https://github.com/deltaone/dotNetModdingTools[/url]

[b]Tested on SDV v1.2.14[/b]
